head: Disney+ on Meta Quest now has 60+ 3D movies and themed screens
dek: The updated Disney+ app on Meta Quest streams more than 60 movies in 3D, including The Avengers and Black Panther, for subscribers.
details: Some films can also be watched in themed virtual places, like Tatooine for Star Wars: A New Hope or the Scare Floor for Monsters, Inc. The update is rolling out now.
means: If you have a Quest and Disney+, you can watch some movies in 3D at no extra cost.
todo: Update the Disney+ app on your Quest and look for the 3D titles.
